runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, unable to quickened. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, stayed on final 200m, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。最後二百米保持走勢，未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled well behind on rail and waited with, snuck closer on the inside after straightening but ran out of room from 300M out and forced to check and stumbled over 100M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 遙居於後，留力候上，走內欄。入直路後在內疊追近，但自三百米處起空位不足。一百米處被迫勒避，失蹄，從未恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Hampered soon after start, held up in last pair, headway up inside rail final 150m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後瞬即受阻礙，留居最後兩位之內。最後一百五十米沿內欄追前。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, picked off weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。末段超越已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Taken back from gate 8, positioned 3 wide with cover, 4 lengths or so back, there to turn, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自第八檔出閘後留後，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Sat near the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke fairly and settled midfield the rail, stayed at the same pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內欄。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Waited with in rear, checked 350m out, passed a few tiring rivals, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處勒避。超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 400M, taken wide in straight and made good progress to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, rail position, ridden to chase leader 350m out, no extra 150m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。三百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, angled out 550M, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。五百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 to 3 wide towards rear of midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二至第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield early, 3 wide on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Made running, pressed on 400m out, headed 200m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 帶頭競跑。四百米處受催策。二百米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W6W) Held up, last and wide into home straight, stayed on final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W6W) 留後。入直路時居包尾位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away awkwardly, quickly recovered to be 3rd tucked in the trail, had difficulty obtaining clear passage over final stages, unable to be fully tested, excusable.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，迅速恢復走勢，居第三位，緊隨對手。末段難以望空。未能全力施為。落敗情有可原。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 3 wide at rear, 5-1/2L back turning in, taken wide in straight and made little progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced slightly better than midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍前位置。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, bumped 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。一百米處被碰撞，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Settled midfield, no clear run at the early Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初未能望空。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Ridden to soon recover from moderate start to 5th within 3L of pace, drifted over 4L back when tempo increased at about 800M, slightly further back in 6th 500M out, fought on steadily in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策，瞬即恢復走勢，居第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。約八百米處步速加快時墮退，落後逾四個馬位。五百米處略為墮居第六位。直路上持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Towards rear on rail, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, just over 4L back into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。入直路時落後稍逾四個馬位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Crowded soon after start, recovered to take up mid-field position, headway 200m out, flattened out final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步後瞬即受擠迫，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。二百米處上前。最後五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, similar position on turn, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上略為追前，取得季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, driven along to chase leaders 500m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Dropped in from wide draw, keen mid-race, pushed along over 500m out, no response to pressure, eased when well held 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。中段搶口。五百米處受推策。對催策毫無反應，二百米處落後甚遠時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched to chase leaders 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處轉換跑線以追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W3W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, made minor headway in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled midfield one off, showed some progress final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear, dropped back approaching the Turn, no contention (Unacceptable Performance, Must BT).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。趨近直路彎時墮退。從未參與競逐。（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Began awkwardly, no early speed, raced at tail, still well back on turn, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘笨拙，缺乏前速，居包尾位置。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) In rear throughout, held and struggling from top of home straight.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 沿途居後列。自直路初起受困，掙扎上前。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, gave ground in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the outside, 5 lengths or so back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held up after sluggish start, short of room 250m out to 100m out, never competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，留後。二百五十米處至一百米處之間空位不足。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after bumped heavily out of stall, pushed along towards centre of course 400m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘時發生大力碰撞，其後居後列。四百米處受推策，在接近跑道中央競跑。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W6W) Began awkwardly, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made very good progress in straight to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W6W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Awkward start, three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat handy, raced wide, gave ground quickly near 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。接近三百米處時迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled within 3L of pace in 5th, commenced move entering straight but faded under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。入直路時開始上前，但最後三百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Began awkwardly and sat prominent outside the leader, overraced in the early stages, failed to sustain his run and compounded rapidly at the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居領放馬外側位置。早段搶口。後勁不繼。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled handy, lay in in the Straight, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。直路上內閃。對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, gave ground entering the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。入直路時墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, driven along 700m out, soon well held, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策，瞬即遙遙落後。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well from a poor draw but soon taken back to last few, remained in rear into straight, ran on past well-beaten horses in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留居最後數位之內。入直路時仍居後列。末段追前，超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, rail position, chased leaders off bend, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) In rear after stumbled leaving stalls, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘時失蹄，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well, raced prominently on the inside, allowed rival to cross near 900M, sat right behind the leader on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走內疊。接近九百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎緊隨領放馬。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (6W5W3W4W) Very wide around first bend after beginning from the widest draw, gradually settled in 4th or 5th 3-wide without cover in back straight, dropped out of contention quickly inside final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(6W5W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，轉首個彎位時走大外疊。對面直路上逐漸居第四或第五位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後四百米迅速墮退，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, failed to respond when asked, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列。對催策毫無反應。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W1W1W) Away with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, no clear run early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路早段未能望空，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W2W3W) Drawn wide, held up last, pushed along from top of home straight, stayed on down the outside, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。自直路初起受推策。在外疊保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in last few, made up good ground in home straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Prominent and wide early after beginning from the widest draw, gradually drifted over 3L back 3-wide 1000M out, gained 6th briefly in a similar position on top of home bend, faded into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 自大外檔出閘，早段居前列，走外疊。一千米處逐漸墮退，落後逾三個馬位，走第三疊。直路初居相若位置，一度進佔第六位。入直路時力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground settling in midfield on rail after moderate start, came under pressure into home straight, ran on steadily but unable to peg back the winner throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘普通，笨拙及失地，其後居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時受催策，沿途以穩勢上前，但未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, taken wider 500m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。五百米處被帶出較外疊。直路初受催策，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden along to hold position 700m out, good headway up rail final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處受催策以保持位置。最後二百米沿欄追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Lacked early pace and had to settle further back in the field along the outside fence, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段欠缺前速，居後列，走外欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead in the middle stages, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner in the closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。中段輕鬆帶頭。直路上保持佳勢，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, kept on same pace until no clear run final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。保持同速，直至最後五十米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W4W) Sat 4 wide no cover midfield, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 3/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Crowded start, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, peaked on run 500M, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。五百米處未能再增速。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Prominent early, tracking leaders halfway, struggling to hold position final bend, soon weakened.
(Sustained a small abrasion to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small abrasion to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W) 早段居前列，半程時跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎難以保持位置，瞬即轉弱。
（右前腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Shifted out and heavily bumped out of stalls, disputed lead 700m out, ridden top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及與對手互相大力碰撞。七百米處爭奪領先。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat handy, traveled fairly, could not be ridden out when positioned close to heels.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢一般。末段在靠近他駒的後蹄時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, tracked leaders, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Showed good speed to across, headed 250m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，切入內疊。二百五十米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, peaked on run near 400M, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。接近四百米處時未能再增速。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 400m out, headed by rivals 100m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。四百米處加速。一百米處被對手超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Prominent, outpaced and dropped to rear halfway, clear run 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 居前列。未能跟上步速，半程時墮居後列。二百米處望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Slightly slow out and made contact, positioned 2 wide in midfield, same position on turn, finished off well to take a place, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘稍慢，觸碰他駒。居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎保持相同位置。衝刺良佳，取得季軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, keen 800m out, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。八百米處搶口。未能望空直至二百米處。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Mid-field, tight for room 400m out, stayed on final 300m but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。四百米處空位不足。最後三百米保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Raced in touch, chased leaders from top of home straight, stuck to task but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。持續力拼，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 5-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, closed off fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Began awkwardly, raced 3 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well but always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，但一直稍為落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 3 wide behind midfield, difficult to settle in the early stages, 3 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。早段難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Awkward start, settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以佳勢上前，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Inconvenienced at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受妨礙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Ridden forward early from wide draw but unable to hold position, soon in rear, wide into home straight, stayed on, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘，早段在催策下上前，但未能保持位置，瞬即墮居後列。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Impeded shortly after start, settled in mid-field, checked when short of room 350m out, switched inside against rail for clear run 250m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久受阻，居中間位置。三百五十米處在空位不足下勒避。二百五十米處移入內欄以望空。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Tracked pace, took closer order from halfway but three wide, faded final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。自半程起進佔較接近位置，但走第三疊。最後二百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat last 2 wide, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居包尾位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, some headway on bend, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路彎略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, awkwardly placed near 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初對催策反應平平。接近一百五十米處時處於窘境。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat rear, held up for clear running until 150M, could not be ridden out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列。受困而未能望空直至一百五十米處。未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length on turn, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。直路彎領先一個馬位。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Missed the start, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 漏閘，居後列，走外疊。中段略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually close home, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Showed speed to lead, pressed in front, headed by winner 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 展現前速以領放，受追迫。三百米處被頭馬超越，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, hard ridden early in straight, checked near 200M, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初受力策。接近二百米處時勒避。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader out wide, short-lived challenge top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走外疊。直路早段一度發力展開挑戰。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at tail, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第九檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, gave ground inside 250M, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。二百五十米處墮退。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Showed good speed to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 展現甚快前速，領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) In rear after sluggish start, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled okay, weakened passing the 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 在力策下取得領先，走勢尚可。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well in the middle stages, headed near 300M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展步迅速，受催策上前領放。中段走勢良佳，接近三百米處時被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈現疲態，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast break, made all, quickened top of home straight, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。直路初加速。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway on bend, ridden top of home straight to challenge leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前。直路初在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, slightly weakened passing 200M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在力策下領放。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至二百米處。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on rail, 3 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
(Jockey dropped whip near 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。
（騎師於接近二百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於接近二百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, set strong pace, headed top of home straight, bumped and lost balance 250m out, well beaten.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，以快步速領放。直路初被超越。二百五十米處被碰撞，失去平衡。所負甚遠。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sluggish start, settled in rear of mid-field, forced to steady on heels 550m out, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置。五百五十米處被迫收慢避開他駒的後蹄。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, 2-1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後二又四分一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, raced keenly throughout, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。沿途搶口。直路上迅速墮退，遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Began fast and dictated things in front, run peaked 150m out and knocked up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭。一百五十米處未能再增速。迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Jumped awkwardly settling in rear of midfield in 8th or 7th fought on steadily in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後的第七或第八位。直路上持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, no clear run top of the Straight, ran on okay once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空，望空後走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。保持穩勢至終點（見競賽事件報告）。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (4W3W2W2W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 自第九檔出閘後留後。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 400M, very wide into straight, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W1W1W) Held up last from widest draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時須等待空位出再出。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on outer, bumped near 450M, very wide into straight, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近四百五十米處時被碰撞。入直路時走大外疊。以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W2W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰。居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W2W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 450M, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過四百五十米處後向外移出。入直路時落後約三個馬位。衝刺凌厲，取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Began well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, steadied near 100M, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近一百米處時收慢，其後再次收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, closed off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Held up in rear, pushed along over 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 留居後列。四百米處受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W) Settled handy, traveled wide, weakened passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。跑過二百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, headed near 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。接近二百米處時被超越，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, limited response when asked, could not be ridden out when racing tight over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。對催策反應平平。末段緊迫競跑時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen early, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, challenged up rail from 350m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自三百五十米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, followed winner into home straight, lacked pace to hold position from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時跟隨頭馬上前。自直路初起未能增速以保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) In rear after bumped out of stalls, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，其後居後列。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自最外檔出閘普通，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, unable to further quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路上未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight but dropped away quickly, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位，但迅速墮退。末段洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid-field towards centre of course, under pressure 400m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide towards rear, 8-1/2L back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後八個半馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide throughout, tracked pace, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，沿途走外疊。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact at start, raced towards rear on the middle track, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時發生觸碰。居後列，在跑道中央競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Jumped well from the widest draw, taken back to race at tail, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，留居尾列。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on outer, 5 lengths or so back in the middle stages, finished off very strongly to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。中段落後約五個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 600m out, dropped away in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped well, taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bounded as stalls opened, rail position in rear of mid-field, headway halfway out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 開閘時向上跳躍，居中間之後位置，走內欄。半程時上前。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 900M, 2 lengths or so back on turn, angled out 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened final 200M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。接近九百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎落後約兩個馬位。五百米處向外移出。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in last pair top of home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, still 9 Ls back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時仍落後九個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, under pressure throughout, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。沿途受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 8 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自最外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, showed no early speed, raced at rear on the outside, 8 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，但未能展現前速，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Raced in touch, chased down leaders under pressure over 200m out, stayed on well, beaten little distance in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, made good ground along the inside. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段沿內疊追前甚多。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, was hampered over the concluding stages, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居前列，走勢良佳。末段受阻礙。其後衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Bumped start, positioned 2 wide, 1-1/2L back, angled out after passing 600M, showed good response early in straight, peaked 200M, ran on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，落後一個半馬位，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。直路初對催策反應良佳。二百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Disputed lead, ridden to lead outright 300m out, challenged from 200m out, responded gamely when runner-up got upsides 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 爭奪領先。受催策，三百米處單騎領放。自二百米處起受挑戰，一百米處被亞軍馬匹追上，但對催策反應甚佳掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed very good response early in straight, took the lead 200M, peaked and headed 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應甚佳。二百米處取得領先。五十米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) From wide draw pressed forward to be tracking leaders, raced wide no cover throughout, responded well from 400M to briefly go 2nd mid-straight, couldn't sprint with leaders final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，受催策上前以跟隨領先馬匹。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。自四百米處起對催策反應良佳。直路中段一度進佔第二位。末段未能與領先馬匹一起衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled handy, held up in the early Straight, closed off reasonably well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路早段受困，末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Held up in wide position, some headway final 300m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 留後，走外疊。最後三百米略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) In touch, raced wide, soon lost ground turning into home straight, held when hampered 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。轉入直路時瞬即失地。二百米處受阻礙時受困。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover, 2 lengths or so back, carried wider 550M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，落後約兩個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百五十米處被帶出更外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled greenly, had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early Straight, showed dash over the final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走勢稚嫩。直路初難以望空。最後一百米加速上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced at the rear over 5Ls off the pace, plenty to do turning for home but was just fair through the line. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後領放馬逾五個馬位。轉直路彎時落後甚遠，但僅能保持一般走勢至終點。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, dropped back from wide draw to race near last, couldn't improve in the straight and was never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘笨拙，墮居接近包尾位置。直路上未能推進，從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Sat off pace 1 off the stands rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;居領放馬之後，走外欄第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Soon drifted well back from a poor draw, trailed the field most of the way to straight, made some late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即遙居於後。直路前大部分途程尾隨馬群。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced at tail, 8 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Street Boss from Spirit Of Carbine, a daughter of Danehill Dancer. Horses by the same sire include Sturdy Ruby and King Of Fighters. The fellow was given seven trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He made the run and finished third under a hold , beaten by 3/4L, over 1200m AWT in Conghua on February 12. In the latest trial, He sat not far behind the pace and finished sixth under pressure, beaten by 4-1/2Ls over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on September 25. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: Street Boss之後，在港同父馬包括「紅海勁」及「佛亮老撾」等駒，生母出自Danehill Dancer。抵港後七次試閘一次上名。2月12日出試從化泥地1200米，早段領放，末段按韁下跑第三名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近9月25日出試田泥1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬4.5個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, ridden along 500m out but soon headed, dropped away quickly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘後受催策，領放。五百米處受催策，但瞬即被超越。最後一百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Led on the rail, traveled smoothly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 沿欄領放。走勢暢順。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, headed near 600M, shared lead turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，受催策上前領放。接近六百米處時被超越。入直路時與對手並排領先。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W2W) Tracked leader, ridden to challenge over 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處受催策展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Won early battle for lead, pressed on 300m out, headed 100m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 早段取得領先。三百米處受催策。一百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began smartly, raced prominently, took the lead approaching 1000M, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列。趨近一千米處時取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一馬位。直路早段保持佳勢，一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, well placed into home straight, challenged and every chance from 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居好位。自三百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長，但末段未能增速以繼續挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Sluggish start, showed great speed to lead, headed 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，展現甚快前速領放。四百米處被超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders, short of room in home straight until 100m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路上空位不足直至一百米處，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Prominent briefly from a wide barrier but soon taken well back approaching first bend, produced good impression under pressure in home straight, made no further impression inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘，一度居前列，但趨近首個彎位時瞬即留後，遙居後列。直路上在催策下追前甚多。一百米處再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Tracked leaders towards centre of course, under pressure 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)跟隨領先馬匹，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon took up running on rail after moderate start, led until headed shortly after straightening, folded up quickly inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，瞬即取得領先，走內欄。領放，直至入直路後不久被超越。最後二百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W) Tracked leading pair, challenged briefly 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。三百米處一度展開挑戰。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight to hold off the challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，力拒對手的挑戰，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Tracked leaders, switched wide for clear run 600m out, ridden top of home straight, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處移出外疊以望空。直路初受催策，保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, perfectly placed to challenge over 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走第三疊。三百米處居絕佳位置以展開挑戰，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Sat off pace 2 wide, gave ground final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, travelled up smoothly top of the Straight, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路初走勢暢順。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) In last few early stages, forced to check 900M out before pulling forward wide around home bend, fought on under pressure from just over 2L back into straight until finding no extra close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 早段居最後數位內。九百米處被迫勒避。轉直路彎時上前，走外疊。入直路時落後稍逾兩個馬位，在催策下力拼，直至接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Started well from wide draw and across to make running, came under pressure 200m out, challenged by runner-up final 100m, responded and always holding that rival final 50m despite edging left.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入領放。二百米處受催策。最後一百米受亞軍馬匹挑戰。最後五十米雖然向外斜跑，但對催策交出反應，一直力拒該匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, angled out after passing 400M, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 留居後列，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, a length or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居第二位。入直路時落後約一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Made running, headed over 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, same position on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, dropped towards rear on turn, emptied early in straight, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。直路彎墮居後列。直路早段力竭，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield, gave limited response turning home, couldn't sustain run mid-straight then faded to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時對催策反應平平。直路中段無以為繼。其後力竭，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Settled just off the pace on rail, steadied and lost position when crossed by race leader 1000M out, renewed effort in back straight but hampered again when 3rd 550M out, faded steadily from 4th into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 緊隨領放馬，走內欄。一千米處被領放馬過頭後收慢及失位。對面直路上重新發力，但五百五十米處居第三位之際再度受阻礙。入直路時居第四位，其後逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, showed some response early in straight, made contact 200M, steadied near 100M and 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路早段對催策略有反應。二百米處發生觸碰。接近一百米處及五十米處時兩度收慢。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat midfield, briefly held up in the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。直路上一度受困。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Box seat, driven along to chase leader 550m out, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。五百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。自四百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Raced prominently, brief effort 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 居前列。三百米處一度發力。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Well there, chased leader around home bend and into straight, faded gradually.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 早段居好位。轉直路彎及入直路時追迫領放馬。逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Held up last, raced wide throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 留居包尾位置，沿途走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled reasonably well, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide midfield, nothing extra. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled well back from the widest draw and waited with, became last 900M out rounding home bend, shifted wider into straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居後列，留力候上。九百米處轉直路彎時居包尾位置。入直路時移出較外疊。末段沿跑道中央在催策下追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 2 wide on very wide into straight, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 留居後列，走內疊。中段搶口，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Began only fairly from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 450M, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, hampered near 200M, made minor progress final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能望空。接近二百米處時受阻礙。最後一百米略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared near 250M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能望空，接近二百五十米處時望空。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Soon taken well back from the widest barrier, wide into straight, found nothing under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘後瞬即遙居於後。入直路時走外疊。末段在催策下再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, driven along 500m out, switched for clear run 200m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列。五百米處受催策。二百米處轉移跑線以望空，但缺乏速度。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled handy, gave ground rounding the Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列。轉直路彎時墮退。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 3 wide, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In touch with leaders, pushed along 300m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受推策，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Began well from gate 13, positioned a length behind the leader on the stands' side, no clear run until final 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;自第十三檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄。未能望空直至五十米處。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier to soon take up running on the rail, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前，瞬即取得領先，走內欄。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚佳前速以領放。直路早段加速，瞬即控制大局，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再加速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Stayed close to leaders, raced keenly in the middle stages when pace was steadied, briefly held up for clear running 400M but couldn't go on afterwards.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 保持緊隨領先馬匹。中段在步速減慢時搶口。四百米處一度受困而未能望空，但其後無以為繼。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from draw 1 and sat in 3rd, had difficulty obtaining clear running passing for some distance passing 250M but the finishing response was only when fair late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第三位。跑過二百五十米處時在一段途程上難以望空，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W3W) From draw 1 stayed close enough to leaders, was repeatedly denied for clear running in the home straight before easing off final 150M when no chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘，保持緊隨領先馬匹。直路上一再未能望空。最後一百五十米在再無爭逐機會下收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Quickly into stride, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L on turn, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎領先四分三馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a steady pace, pulled 3L clear from home bend drawing further away in the straight for an impressive victory.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，以平穩步速領放。自直路彎起帶離三個馬位。直路上進一步帶離，以漂亮姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, ran on strongly, won going away, impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。走勢強勁，帶離勝出。表現出色。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted in shortly after start and made contact, sent forward to take the lead, hard ridden from 300M, peaked and headed 150M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久向內斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，受催策上前領放。自三百米處起受力策。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Prominent, improved to lead against far rail 600m out, driven 400m out, headed by winner 200m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)居前列。沿外欄推進上前，六百米處取得領先。四百米處受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越，未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made running against stand rail, kicked 1.5L clear 300m out, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;沿外欄帶頭。三百米處加速帶離一個半馬位。一百米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, peaked approaching 300M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。趨近三百米處時未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Jumped with them, raced prominently, 2 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden from 300M but failed to quicken, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，走外欄第三疊。自三百米處起受力策，但未能加速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Pressed leader, disputed led from 700m out, quickened early to lead top of home straight but soon headed, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 追迫領放馬，自七百米處起爭奪領先。直路初加速，取得領先，但瞬即被超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden early gradually settling some 2L back in 4th over 600M out, commenced move home bend and ran on under pressure for slender advantage inside the 150M, just held on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 早段受催策，六百米處逐漸居第四位，落後約兩個馬位。直路彎開始發力，受催策上前，一百五十米處以短距離領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, keen early, disputed led final bend, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬，早段搶口。直路彎爭奪領先。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) From draw 10 sent forward vying for early lead, emerged as clear leader going into home turn, kept going well in the straight, headed nearing 150M before fading to finish 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 自第十檔出閘，早段受催策上前爭奪領先。進入直路彎時領放。直路上保持佳勢，接近一百五十米處時被超越，其後力竭，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden to be up with the pace settling one-out-one-back 650M out, fought on steadily from a similar position into straight but never threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策以跟上步速。六百五十米處居第二疊第二位。入直路時居相若位置，持續力拼，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kicked clear from the 500M, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。自五百米處起加速帶離對手，保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 800M, took the lead 600M, shared lead with rival turning in, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過八百米處後追近。六百米處取得領先。入直路時與對手並排領先。直路上保持甚佳走勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, forced to steady 400m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處被迫收慢，直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, driven along 450m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, tight for room against rail early in home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初沿欄受緊迫。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Reserved behind midfield along the inside, in similar spot 3Ls off the pace home turn before running on strongly final 300M to take lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎居相若位置，落後領放馬三個馬位。最後三百米以勁勢衝刺，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped back on jumping from a wide draw, raced as the back marker 7Ls off the pace, failed to respond turning home and soon eased. (No Vet findings / Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔躍出後墮後，居包尾位置，落後領放馬七個馬位。轉入直路時對催策毫無反應，瞬即收慢。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat midfield, checked at 150M, never involved afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居中間位置。一百五十米處勒避，其後從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, short-lived effort 300m out, no extra final 200m.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處一度發力。最後二百米再無餘力。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, 4 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，落後約四個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled well back, produced late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;遙居於後。末段略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, ran green in home straight, flattened out final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路上走勢稚嫩。最後二百米洩氣。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well from the rails draw, amongst leaders early before settling one back, drifted further back to some 3L off the pace onto course proper, renewed effort inside final 150M but did not find much room.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自大外檔出閘迅速，早段居領先馬群中，其後落後一個馬位。跑離分支直路時進一步墮退，落後領放馬約三個馬位。最後一百五十米再度發力，但空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in midfield, fought on steadily without making any serious challenge in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路上持續力拼，但未能真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Crowded for room after the start, ended up racing at the back of the field, had some work to do top of the straight, closed off fastest and almost claimed 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後受擠迫，居包尾位置。直路初落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，幾乎跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in last few, 3-wide rounding home bend and baulked for a run in home straight until barged his way out over 50M out
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時走第三疊。直路上受困，直至五十米處取位上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, commenced move approaching 350M, very wide turning in, finished off very strongly to make frame, nearest finish. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。趨近三百五十米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，取得第四名。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat midfield, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居中間位置。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield 3-wide, came wide into straight before closing off the race mildly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時走外疊，其後衝刺普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。二百米處望空。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled off rail 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, some headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路彎略為追前。直路上持續上前，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W2W3W) Settled well back on the fence, moved off the rail in the middle stages, closed off fairly over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 遙居於後，走內欄。中段移離內欄。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 900M, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘笨拙，其後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。九百米處移入內欄，直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處時未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by I Am Invincible from Tangier, a daughter of Medaglia d'Oro. Horses by the same sire include Invincible Shield and Pi Legend. This fellow had eight starts for one win (a 3yo maiden handicap over 1650m). He was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished third under pressure, beaten by 3/4L, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on September 29. He looks nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「至高無極」(I Am Invincible)之後，在港同父馬包括「笑傲江湖」及「偵探傳奇」等駒，生母出自「金獎章」(Medaglia d'Oro)。來港前在澳洲八戰得一勝，頭馬為一場1650米三歲從未勝出馬讓磅賽。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。最近9月29日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Bumped out of stalls, three wide in rear, keen middle stages, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列，走第三疊。中段搶口。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted in shortly after start and made contact, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久向內斜跑及發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, showed good response early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Moderately away, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, similar position on turn, kept on well in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎位置相若。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Stayed prominent to the pace in early and middle stages, came under serious pressure 500M, dropped away quickly on straightening.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 早段及中段居前列位置。五百米處受力策。入直路時迅速墮退。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders throughout, in 5th spot from 800M, had his chance but ran home only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 沿途保持落後領先馬匹不遠。自八百米處起居第五位。已獲機會盡展所長，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out 550M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出，入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W3W) Moderately away from the widest draw, trapped wide in midfield, moved closer after passing 800M, 2nd on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W3W) 自最外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過八百米處後追近。直路彎居第二位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Rear of mid-field, headway 300m out, unable to sustain and no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。三百米處追前。末段無以為繼，未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced better than midfield on the outside, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled handy, traveled nicely, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走勢良佳。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Began well from a poor draw but gradually taken back remaining wide throughout, reached second last into straight, renewed effort inside final 200M producing good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但逐漸留後。沿途走外疊。入直路時居尾二位置。最後二百米重新發力。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide no cover, ran on strongly, just got caught on the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。走勢強勁，僅於終點線上被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Sat behind mid, traveled strongly, lay in inside 200M, showed dash over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢強勁。二百米處內閃。末段加速上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, hampered near 700M, 5 lengths back turning in, finished off strongly to score.
(Sustained a wound to the left hind cannon.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a wound to the left hind cannon.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後五個馬位，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。
（左後腿管骨部位有傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, chased the leader, weakened inside 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Settled midfield, raced keenly in the middle stages, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Crowded shortly after start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, made no progress final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久受擠迫，落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Rear of mid-field, little response to pressure 300m out, well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處對催策無甚反應，遙遙落後。
