runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Broke well from the one draw settling just off the pace on rail, remained in 3rd but further away from pacemaker in back straight, within 2L when 2nd turning in for home, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。對面直路上仍居第三位，但進一步落後領放馬。入直路時居第二位，落後不逾兩個馬位。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, restrained to race near last, driven along 500M, held up briefly near 200M but never going the pace to challenge leaders. (Jockey - no explanation for the disappointing performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，受約束，居接近包尾位置。五百米處受催策。接近二百米處時一度受困，但速度不足以挑戰領先馬匹。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, switched and driven 400m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處轉換跑線及受催策。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, keen early, ridden on bend to chase leaders out wide, short-lived effort 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。早段搶口。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹，走外疊。三百米處一度上前。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Jumped well from gate 9, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, didn't travel with much fluency early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，早段走勢欠順。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Clumsy start losing ground, soon recovered to forward of midfield on rail some 3L off the pace in 5th, angled out for a run entering straight but unable to quicken to threaten, hampered and faded 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間之前第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。進入直路時向外移出取位，但未能加速以構成威脅。受阻礙，五十米處力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) In midfield early stages before moving closer to track leaders entering home turn, driven final 200M and went to the line well. (Jockey - requested to take up a forward position from wide draw.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段居中間位置。入直路彎時追近，跟隨領先馬匹。最後二百米受催策。末段衝刺良佳。（騎師表示，他獲指示讓自外檔出閘的坐騎佔取前列位置。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon dropped to last few, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily in straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即墮居最後數位之內。入直路時走內疊節省腳程。直路上穩步上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked leaders, tended to hang right throughout, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。沿途傾向內閃。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W3W) Wide throughout, forward move to chase leaders 500m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W3W) 沿途走外疊。五百米處上前追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, briefly hampered 500m out, short of room 100m out, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處一度受阻礙。一百米處空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Trailed the field throughout after slow start, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後沿途尾隨馬群。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W4W) Jumped only fairly , settled at the back of the field, brought wide into straight but gave no response.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居馬群後列。入直路時移出外疊，但對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat behind midfield near center track, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat near the rear on the rail, lay in and never seriously tested, did made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居後列，走外欄。內閃，從未能真正施為。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。衝刺良佳，取得亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled at the rear 3 wide, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Moderate start, gradually recovered along rail to be up with the pace after the first 200M, shifted 2L back to 4th 600M out on top of home bend, renewed effort inside final 200M but never threatened the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，其後沿欄逐漸恢復走勢，過了首二百米後跟上步速。六百米處直路彎早段居第四位，落後兩個馬位。最後二百米重新發力，但從未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, checked 200M, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處勒避。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Taken back to the rear from wide draw, remained in last 400M 5Ls to make up, came from well back and made some inroads, but couldn't get into it.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。四百米處仍居包尾位置，落後五個馬位。自遙遙落後的位置略為追前，但未能上前爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat midfield 3 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden 3-wide in midfield early stages, 6th 2-wide rounding home bend, ran on in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時居第六位，走第二疊。直路上追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Gradually settled in midfield and wide without cover, remained in similar position into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 逐漸居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Raced in touch, keen to halfway, good headway from 300m out, led 100m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，半程前搶口。自三百米處起追前甚多。一百米處取得領先，末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W4W) Mid-field, three wide, stayed on steadily final 300m, overhauled runner-up to lead late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。最後三百米保持穩勢。末段超越亞軍馬匹，取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, made contact with the right side of its starting gate and lost ground, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，觸碰閘廂右側，因而失地，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Awkward start, rail position in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至三百米處。保持走勢，但未能增速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Tracked leader, unable to quicken 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處未能加速，末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Sat 3 wide no cover in front of midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, closed off nicely, just lost in a photo.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，在電眼判決下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Wide in mid-field, keen mid-race, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。中段搶口。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in first few, drifted over 2L back in 5th 800M out, slightly worse into straight but recovered some late ground closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 受催策，居前列。八百米處墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時略為墮後，但末段收復部分失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Ridden forward gradually from a wide barrier to join the leader 800M out, came under pressure again from 500M out but folded up quickly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下逐漸上前，八百米處追上領放馬。自五百米處起再度受催策，但入直路後迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run approaching 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。趨近一百米處時未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began from a wide barrier, took up running after first 100M and rails run 900M out onto first turn, steadied up the pace rounding home bend, led until swamped when no extra inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘。跑了一百米後進佔領先位置。九百米處首次轉彎時走內欄。轉直路彎時減慢步速。末段領放，直至最後五十米再無餘力，被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Slowly away, wide towards rear, hung left halfway, very wide turning into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走外疊。半程時外閃。入直路時走大外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat on pace, weakened inside 150M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Away with them, raced prominently, 2 wide, same position on turn, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed 150M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。三百米處取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, faded under pressure final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。最後二百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened final 150M.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。最後一百五十米轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked leaders, driven along 450m out, hung out final 400m, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受催策。最後四百米外閃。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away well, took the early lead, headed 600M, 2nd on turn, peaked 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段領放。六百米處被超越。直路彎居第二位。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed speed to get across, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現前速以切入內疊。直路初受催策。三百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat handy, weakened final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列。最後四百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, no clear room in the Straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上未能望空。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped exiting stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時被碰撞，居中間之後位置。四百米處受推策。超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W5W) Hampered start, raced towards rear on the outside, ridden from 450M but showed no response, eased final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
Roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W5W) 起步時受阻礙，居後列，走外疊。自四百五十米處起受催策，但毫無反應。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Shown good early speed to lead, kept on strongly, always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。末段保持勁勢，足以取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Began well, raced in 3rd, a length or so back, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run 100M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後約一個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策略有反應。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, lacked pace to challenge, eased when detached 150m out.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。一百五十米處被拋離之際收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, finished off well, just missed out on 2nd in a photo.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。衝刺良佳，在電眼判決下僅失亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, ridden final bend to hold position, lost touch final 200m.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎在催策下保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, pushed along 600m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受推策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in rear of mid-field against rail, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之後位置，走外欄。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide towards rear, 3 wide from 600M, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside the lead, travelled keenly, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側，搶口。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Pressed forward after moderate start from the wideset barrier before settling 3-wide without cover in 5th just over 2L back, 3L 6th 3-wide rounding home bend, ran on in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘普通後受催策上前，其後居第五位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時居第六位，落後三個馬位，走第三疊。直路上追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly from draw 1, settled in the group chasing leaders, responded well on straightening, led nearing 200M, kept on to the line but couldn't hold off winner final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居於追趕領先馬匹的馬群中。入直路時對催策反應良佳，接近二百米處時領先，但最後一百五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能展開真正挑戰。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W3W) Rear of mid-field, wide throughout, stayed on steadily final 200m, went third late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，沿途走外疊。最後二百米保持穩勢。末段進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced at rear on the inside, 2 wide in the middle stages, angled out early in straight, cleared 200M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走內疊。中段走第二疊。直路早段向外移出。二百米處望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, bumped 1050m out, settled in mid-field, responded to pressure from 300m out, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞。一千零五十米處碰撞對手，居中間位置。自三百米處起受催策，交出反應。保持佳勢，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Rear of mid-field, stayed on for pressure, lacked pace to trouble leaders but promising debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。在催策下保持走勢。速度不足以威脅領先馬匹，但初出表現不俗。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Nicconi from Vichy, a daughter of Cape Blanco. Horses by the same sire include Country Dancer and Copartner Fleet. He was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh under slight pressure, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「利確來」(Nicconi)之後，在港同父馬包括「鄉村樂韻」及「合夥飛馳」等駒，生母出自「布蘭高角」(Cape Blanco)。抵港後試閘三次。最近10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第七名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Admire Mars from Zurla, a daughter of Not A Single Doubt. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. He was given seven trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished second under slight pressure, beaten by a short-head, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on April 27. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fifth under the whip, beaten by 2Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 28. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「頌讚火星」(Admire Mars)之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「勇無疑」(Not A Single Doubt)。抵港後七次試閘一次上名。4月27日出試從化草地1000米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬短馬頭位。最近9月28日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第五名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Zousain from Mosaqua, a daughter of Mossman. Horses by the same sire include Salon S and Papaya Brose. He was given six trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 4-1/4Ls, over 800m on turf in Conghua on May 18. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished third under the whip, beaten by 1/2L, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 5. He's not really looking like a first-up winner and this run will give us a better guide as to how he's going.
formguide.comments_chi: 「蘇醒」(Zousain)之後，在港同父馬包括「極上紗瓏」及「禾道豐」等駒，生母出自Mossman。抵港後六次試閘兩次上名。5月18日出試從化草地800米，早段並頭領放，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬4.25個馬位。最近10月5日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段鞭策下跑第三名，落後頭馬半個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 100M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。一百米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace, unable to quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted out at start and made contact, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked on run 400M, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時向外斜跑及發生觸碰，落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。四百米處未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, chased leaders from 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear after slow start, ran green, stayed on late down the wide outside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，其後居後列，走勢稚嫩。末段保持走勢，遠離外欄競跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the middle track in the early stages, peaked on run approaching 500M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，在跑道中央競跑。趨近五百米處時未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, gave ground quickly in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路上迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Pushed on from a wide gate and sat outside the leader, fought on gamely to finish into placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自外檔出閘後受推策，居領放馬外側。以佳勢力拼，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced in midfield on outer, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Sat behind the leaders, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leader, improved to lead 200m out, headed 75m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領放馬。上前，二百米處取得領先。七十五米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Checked leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 500m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘後勒避，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced close up against rail, pushed along 300m out, no extra final 150m.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處受推策。最後一百五十米再無餘力。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Always thereabouts settling one back on rail behind leader cum eventual winner over 800M out, fought on under pressure but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 沿途居啣接位置。八百米處落後領放馬兼頭馬一個馬位，走內欄。在催策下力拼，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, ridden along to lead, traveled comfortably, led all the way to score (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速。受催策，取得領先，走勢暢順。一放到底，取得勝利。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began well, raced behind midfield on the stands' side, 3 to 4 lengths back in the middle stages, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，靠近外欄競跑。中段落後三至四個馬位。最後四百米超越部分已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, positioned 1-3/4L behind the leader on the inside, same position on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Checked shortly after start, remained in last few to straight, shifted wide for a run making home turn but unable to quicken to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久勒避。入直路前仍居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時移出外疊取位，但未能加速展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Away only fairly, from pole position settled in the box-seat trail, closed off just fairly when shaken up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居包廂位置。末段在催策下衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Mid-division, had to angle out for a run 300m out, soon lost ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處須向外移出取位，瞬即墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden to chase leaders 500m out, lacked pace to challenge, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。未能增速以展開挑戰。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact at start, raced at tail, 7 lengths or so back in the middle stages, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時與他駒互相觸碰。居包尾位置，中段落後約七個馬位。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Began awkwardly, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in rear after slow start, plenty to do 400m out and switched towards centre of track, stayed on, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。四百米處落後甚遠，移至跑道中央。保持走勢，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in rear after slowly away, pushed along towards centre of course 350m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居後列。三百五十米處在跑道中央受推策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat rear, traveled on the rail, minor progress made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, keen mid-race, stayed on for pressure, no threat to winner, passed by runner-up final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。在催策下保持走勢。未能威脅頭馬。最後五十米被亞軍馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away settling at the back, saved ground on rail turning in for home, ran past beaten horses in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段超越已洩氣潰敗的馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced in second half of the field along the 3-path, driven 500M but couldn't quicken, never able to challenge. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後半馬群中，走第三疊。五百米處受催策但未能加速。從未能作出挑戰。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, outpaced and left behind final 500m, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。未能跟上步速，最後五百米被拋離。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, recovered to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，恢復走勢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Shifted in at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 850M, same margin back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。自八百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Soon taken well back from a wide barrier travelling mainly 4-wide without cover, made headway towards rear inside the 850M, one of the widest into straight, ran home one-paced while hanging out under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置，大多走第四疊，沒有遮擋。八百五十米處略為追前至後列。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。末段保持同速，在催策下外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Bumped start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickly lost place early in home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞。追迫領放馬。直路初迅速失位。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on until weakened final 100M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，直至最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced prominently on the inside, allowed rival to cross near 700M, sat right behind the leader on turn, bumped near 250M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居前列，走內疊。接近七百米處時讓對手超越。直路彎緊隨領放馬。接近二百五十米處時發生碰撞。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled towards rear on rail, gained slightly closer around home bend, angled out for a clear run 300M out, responded well under pressure and asserted authority just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉直路彎時略為追近。三百米處向外移出以望空。在催策下反應良佳，跑過一百米處後主宰大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer after passing 700M, 3 wide on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。過了七百米處後略為追近。直路彎走第三疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide in rear of mid-field, commenced move out wide 550m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。五百五十米處開始上前，走外疊。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W2W2W) Hampered leaving stalls, mid-field, keen mid-race, pushed along 300m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W2W2W) 出閘時受阻礙，居中間位置。中段搶口。三百米處受推策，末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W4W) Sat towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, could not make ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Ridden along from wide draw to press leader, pushed along on bend to chase leader, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下追迫領放馬。直路彎受推策以追趕領放馬。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, forced to steady 500m out to avoid a rival that was giving ground, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。五百米處被迫收慢避開一匹正在墮退的對手。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以勁勢上前，一百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fully utilised the inside gate and led the event, failed to show much response in the home straight and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 充分利用內檔優勢，帶頭競跑。直路上對催策未有太大反應，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened and faded in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened gradually final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。三百米處未能再加速，被超越。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, joined by rivals 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初受催策。二百米處被對手追及，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 2-1/2Ls turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先兩個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Strode forward, checked 1500M by a rival who was crossing to the lead, sat outside leader throughout in a fast run race, run ended 250M and weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 展步上前。千五米處被領放的對手過頭時勒避。在賽事步速偏快下沿途居領放馬外側。二百五十米處再無餘力及轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide without cover in midfield after beginning from a wide barrier, shifted back to 11th for cover 3-wide approaching first bend 1000M out, made no impression from wide into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處趨近首個彎位時留居第十一位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走外疊，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on okay, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持不俗走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Heavily bumped and lost balance shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, good headway halfway out, ran on well to close on leaders but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久被大力碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。半程時以佳勢上前。走勢良佳，追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear after awkward start, never any room to open up from 300m out, coasted past a few rivals final 150m, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，其後居後列。自三百米處起從未能望空。最後一百五十米輕鬆超越數匹對手。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W6W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, made contact near 1000M and 850M, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W6W) 留居後列，走外疊。接近一千米處及八百五十米處時兩度與對手互相觸碰。入直路時走大外疊。直路早段略為追前，最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W5W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, settled at the tail of the field 7-8L, switched wide turning for home and had work to do, made some progress without threatening leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居包尾位置，落後七至八個馬位。轉入直路時移出外疊，落後頗遠。其後略為追前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Sluggish start, three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along 600m out, hampered and lost balance 250m out, eased off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。六百米處受推策。二百五十米處受阻礙，失去平衡。收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, some limited headway when running out of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。末段略為追前，最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear, held up between 400M to 300M, responded reasonably well when placed under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。四百米處至三百米處之間受困。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Shifted out, made contact and lost ground out of stalls, held up last, switched inside for clear run early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 躍出時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰及失地，留居包尾位置。直路初向內移入以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked turning in, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時未能再增速。直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival turning in, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時與對手並排領先。直路初未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W) Chased leader, under pressure to challenge leaders 550m out, stayed on steadily, tight for room close home, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。五百五十米處在催策下挑戰領先馬匹。保持穩勢，接近終點時受緊迫，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Out with rest, sent forward to take the early lead, headed near 850M, 2nd on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，早段受催策上前領放。接近八百五十米處時被超越。直路彎居第二位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed 250m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速，二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, tended to shift right in home straight, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上傾向向內斜跑。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped and lost balance out of stalls, three wide in mid-field without cover, dropped away quickly 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞及失去平衡，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。三百米處迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W6W) Made contact at start, raced slightly behind midfield on outer, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W6W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled just behind the lead, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened and faded in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Unacceptable Performance, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路上轉弱及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, one pace when asked
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) One of the first few away and tracked leaders, stuck on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘最快數駒之一，跟隨領先馬匹。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Disputed led in three wide, ridden top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先，走第三疊。直路初受催策。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well from draw 1 and able to lead the race at steady tempo, headed near 200M, weakened final stages but managed to hang on for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，能以穩定步速領放。接近二百米處時被超越。末段轉弱，但仍能保住季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Average to begin, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, blocked off when going for run 400m out to 150m out, checked when trying to improve 100m out, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處至一百五十米處之間在試圖取位之際受困。一百米處在嘗試推進之際勒避。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat off midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Sat at the rear, never impress. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居後列。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled handy, gave ground quickly entering the Straight, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列。入直路時迅速墮退。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, effort 400m out, weakened final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處發力。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Settled ahead of midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running 300M but the finishing response was only fair after. (Trainer - Instructed jockey to take up a forward position on the Yielding track.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置。三百米處難以望空，但其後衝刺僅屬一般。（練馬師表示，他指示騎師在「黏地」狀況的跑道上讓此駒佔取前列位置。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Crowded start, raced at tail throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 起步時受擠迫。沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly and ended up racing in last, under pressure 500M out and soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，其後居包尾位置。五百米處受催策。瞬即再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, short of room early in home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路早段空位不足。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, gave ground early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Well back dropping to tail-end inside the 600m, made no impression thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 遙居於後。六百米處墮居包尾位置，其後毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Slowly away, driven along and outpaced early stages, still well held from top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘緩慢。早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。直路初仍遙遙落後。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden along 400m out, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。入直路時居好位。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on without threatening top 3.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持走勢，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Caught 3-wide without cover chasing leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M and weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began awkwardly, trailed the field to straight, widest turning in for home, only ran past well-beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙。直路前尾隨馬群。轉入直路時走最外疊。僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Took up the front-running position early and posted some very fast sectionals, folded up quickly over final stages and had to pay the price.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段取得領先，以甚快步速領放。耗力太多，末段迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled midfield, raced wide throughout, weakened passing 250M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。沿途走外疊。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Settled in mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段以佳勢上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W) Taken back from gate 14, raced 3 wide with cover at rear, wider turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W) 自第十四檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, forced to switch around winner 300m out, ran on strongly to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處被迫繞過頭馬轉換跑線。走勢強勁，追近領放馬，但一直落後該駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made good progress to take a place. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後固守內疊，追前甚多，跑獲季軍。（見競賽事件報告。）
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Settled 3-wide in last few after moderate start, commenced move 600M out swinging wider into straight, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish while hanging in.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘普通，居最後數位之內，走第三疊。六百米處開始上前，入直路時移出較外疊。以穩勢上前，內閃，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at tail, 7 lengths or so back, checked near 600M, still last turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後約七個馬位。接近六百米處時勒避。入直路時仍居包尾位置，直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unbale to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Dipped at start before settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, angled out 500M out for a run into straight, tightened and lost position 200M out and ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘時將頭低俯，其後居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。五百米處向外移出，入直路時取得空位。二百米處受緊迫及失位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, ridden along 600m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。六百米處受催策。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, switched out in the Straight, ran on nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段以佳勢上前，僅保住冠軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎難以保持位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, headway into contention 200m out, stayed on between horses despite being tight for room.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。二百米處上前爭勝。儘管在馬匹之間受緊迫，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 150M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近一百五十米處時取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點。從容取勝。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced at rear, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, made good progress after passing 300M, no clear run towards finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後追前甚多。末段未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide towards rear, 3 wide after passing 650M, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居後列，走第二疊。跑過六百五十米處後走第三疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race at tail, 8-1/2L back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，留居尾列。入直路時落後八個半馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position final bend, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 300M, took the lead 150M, kept on well to the line. (Finished 1st, demoted to 2nd.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。趨近三百米處時向外移出。一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢。（以第一名過終點，被貶為亞軍。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled okay, lay out over the final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走勢尚可。最後一百米外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初一度發力。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Pressured when sharing the lead, weakened over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 並排領先下受追迫。末段轉弱。（ 見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Well there, became 3rd some 1.5L back rounding home bend, renewed effort over 600M out sharing lead into straight, folded up quickly inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居好位。轉直路彎時居第三位，落後約一個半馬位。六百米處重新發力。入直路時並排領先。最後一百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed speed to get across, headed by rivals top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現前速以切入內疊。直路初被對手超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled 3 wide near midfield, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, pressured for lead and one of three that raced clear to halfway, headed over 200m out, weakened, eased final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。在催策下保持領先位置，為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處被超越，轉弱。最後五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 200M, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後二百米未能抗衡頭馬，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced prominently, took the lead near 1250M, led by a length in the middle stages, kept on well in straight, shifted out abruptly 100M, always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列。接近一千二百五十米處時取得領先。中段領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢。一百米處急促向外斜跑。保持領放至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat towards the rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W4W) Sat rear, improved and switched out approaching the corner, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W4W) 居後列。趨近直路彎時推進及向外移出。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled towards rear, fought on steadily in home straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。直路上持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked pace, improved between horses to lead 200m out, in control final 50m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。在馬匹之間推進，二百米處取得領先。最後五十米控制大局。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sluggish getaway and crowded shortly after the start, made up decent late ground last 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，其後不久受擠迫。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken forward from wide draw and tracked leader, challenged and every chance to 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後上前，跟隨領放馬。其後展開挑戰，一百五十米處前已獲機會盡展所長，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped exiting stalls, raced in touch with leaders, unable to hold position by 600m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，緊隨領先馬匹。六百米處未能保持位置。洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W) After 100m raced very awkwardly, became unbalanced and hung left, lost considerable ground in the process and quickly tailed off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W) 跑了一百米後走勢非常笨拙，失去平衡及外閃，因而失地甚多，瞬即居包尾位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped on jumping, trapped very wide early, a length or so back, 2 wide from 900M, same margin back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 躍出時發生碰撞，早段落後約一個馬位，走大外疊。自九百米處起走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled handy, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place entering home straight, checked 300m out, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時仍居包尾位置。三百米處勒避。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, forced to steady top of home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初被迫收慢。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, ran on when in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段在望空下追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Prominent briefly and soon dropped to wide in worse than midfield, produced moderate short-lived effort early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 一度居前列，瞬即墮居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路初一度發力，走勢普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Sat midfield, traveled smoothly, switched out rounding the Turn, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Raced in rear after awkward start, switched wide for clear run 300m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，其後居後列。三百米處移出外疊以望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back, same margin back on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a wide barrier setting a steady pace, ridden some 3L clear about 150M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即帶頭，以平穩步速領放。約一百五十米處受催策，帶離約三個馬位。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat off pace on the rail, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。末段以勁勢上前，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer after passing 900M, 4 wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過九百米處後略為追近。入直路時走第四疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, under pressure to chase leaders 500m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out after passing 400M, very wide turning in, weakened and eased early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路初轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards rear, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier settling in midfield between runners, came under pressure to challenge upon straightening but did not find much room until inside the 200M, quickened well to snatch 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，在馬匹之間競跑。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰，但空位不足直至二百米處。以佳勢加速，最後數步跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Across from wide draw and raced outside of leader, took narrow lead 300m out, headed 200m out and no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，居領放馬外側。三百米處以短距離領先。二百米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, struggling in rear when checked 350m out, well held after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，向內移入。在後列掙扎上前，三百五十米處勒避，其後落後頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced at tail, 7-3/4L back turning in, taken wide in straight and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置。入直路時落後七又四分三個馬位。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, ridden top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初受催策。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，但未能構成任何威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W2W) Wide early from high draw, led after 400m, headed 600m out, remained prominent until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段走外疊。跑了四百米後取得領先。六百米處被超越。仍居前列，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) Jumped ok, sat midfield one off the rail, hit the line strongly when asked, just missed by a whisker.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘尚可，居中間位置，走第二疊。在催策下衝刺強勁，僅以短馬頭位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Began well from a middle draw, settled down 2-wide in midfield, lay in when placed under pressure in the home straight, ran to the line steadily for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自第七檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上在催策下內閃。末段以穩勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, driven 500m out, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。未能望空直至一百五十米處。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) A bit outpaced early and raced in last place, short of room when trying to improve 300m out, switched and ran on final 250m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 早段略為未能跟上步速，居包尾位置。三百米處在嘗試推進時空位不足。最後二百五十米轉換跑線及追前，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W2W3W) 居後列，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven along 800m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。八百米處受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, angled out early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段向外移出。三百米處望空。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W2W3W) Taken back from gate 8, raced at tail, still 9 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made good progress in the run home to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W2W3W) 自第八檔出閘後留居包尾位置。直路彎仍落後九個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段追前甚多，獲得季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W2W) Held up last, some headway final bend, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, strong run to edge ahead close home in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路彎略為追前。未能望空直至一百五十米處。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide towards rear, similar position on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎位置相若。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Unbalanced at start and soon dropped to last few, commenced move rounding home bend going wide for a run into straight, ran on to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時失去平衡，瞬即墮居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時開始發力，入直路時移出外疊取位。追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W2W) From draw 14 moved up to track leader, pressed along 500M to be challenging for the lead, peaked on its run 200M, couldn't go on. (Trainer - instructed jockey to go forward from wide barrier.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W2W) 自第十四檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬。五百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速，無以為繼。（練馬師指示騎師讓自大外檔出閘的此駒上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch, keen mid-race, stuck on rail and had to wait for run until 300m out, picked up well to challenge, found only winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。沿欄受困，須等待空位出現直至三百米處。末段以佳勢加速以展開挑戰。僅不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Sat handy, raced keenly early, traveled wide, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居前列。早段搶口。走外疊。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped fairly gradually improved to 2L 4th, drifted slightly backward to 4L 6th in midfield onto first bend, renewed effort 500M out shifting 4-wide to challenge into straight, held place chance until swamped inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘一般，逐漸推進至第四位，落後兩個馬位。開始轉首個彎位時略為墮居中間第六位，落後四個馬位。五百米處重新發力。入直路時移至第四疊以展開挑戰。保持入位機會直至最後二百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in last few one off the rail, drifted backward rounding home bend, shifted wide for a run into straight, finished off the race well inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居最後數位之內，走第二疊。轉直路彎時墮後。入直路時移出外疊取位。最後二百米衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled rear on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙。居後列，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Slow to begin, ended up racing in last over 10Ls off the pace, in similar position making the home turn before running past a few beaten horses in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾十個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置。直路上超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Slowly away, held up, no impression when ridden along home straight.
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，留後。直路上在催策下毫無表現。
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W1W1W) Taken back to race at tail, 8 lengths or so back turning in, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約八個馬位，轉入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W5W) Rear of mid-division, headway wide over 400m out, sustained run to lead over 100m out, headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W5W) 居中間之後位置。四百米處在外疊上前。持續上前，一百米處取得領先。接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W) Bumped on jumping, eased back to last from widest draw, still 8L to make up 400M but failed to make ground from the back. (Jockey - raced flat.)
(Lame in left front and right hind legs.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Lame in left front and right hind legs.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W) 自最外檔躍出時發生碰撞，收慢留居包尾位置。四百米處仍落後八個馬位，但未能自後列追前。（騎師表示，坐騎走勢平平。）
（左前腿及右後腿均不良於行。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （左前腿及右後腿均不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W) Settled well back, ran on well inside final 150M to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W) 遙居於後。最後一百五十米走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, moved smoothly into contention 400m out, stayed on well but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處順勢上前挑戰。保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Raced 3-wide in a position behind midfield, brought widest on straightening before closing off fastest to claim 3rd. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時走最外疊，末段衝刺最快，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken well back from the widest draw, snuck up on rail entering home straight, no clear run between the 300 and 200M and forced to steady and switch in for a run, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，遙居後列。入直路時沿欄上前。三百米處至二百米處之間未能望空，被迫收慢及向內移入取位。末段以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, 3 wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide behind midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Stood flat-footed on jumping and lost ground, raced in rear, ridden along 300m out, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 躍出時四蹄滯立及失地，居後列。三百米處受催策，保持走勢，但末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, driven along 500m out, tight for room early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。直路早段受緊迫。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Held up last, pushed along 500m out, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 留居包尾位置。五百米處受推策。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, forced to steady on heels 700m out, angled off rail top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。直路初移離內欄。最後二百米走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Bounded as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, pushed along 500m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 開閘時向上跳躍，失地，居後列。五百米處受推策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 500M, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled well back after beginning from a wide barrier, switched wide into home straight, ran on past well-beaten horses and never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後。入直路時向外移出。上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W2W) Obliged to make use in the early stages to take up a position outside the lead, tracked eventual winner into straight, battled on fairly, lost 2nd nearing 100M and had no extra late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W2W) 早段須受催策以佔取領放馬外側的位置。入直路時跟隨頭馬，直路上走勢一般。接近一百米處時失去第二位，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced prominently but trapped 3 wide, 2 wide from 700M, a length back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第三疊。自七百米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Jumped on terms, chased leader in 2nd, quickened up well under top weight to lead mid-straight, just couldn't hold off winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居第二位，追趕領放馬。在負頂磅下加速良佳，直路中段取得領先。僅最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Average to begin, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 550M, hard ridden after passing 300M, showed very good response, took the lead 100M, kept on very well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。自五百五十米處起走第二疊。跑過三百米處後受力策，對催策反應甚佳，一百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, mid division, switched for clear run top of home straight, stayed on well and just lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置。直路初轉換跑線以望空。保持佳勢，僅失亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out and bumped at start, raced in touch with leaders, keen middle stages, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口。未能望空直至三百米處，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, still last turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 自最外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時仍居包尾位置。直路上移出外疊。末段衝刺強勁，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(4W2W) 居領放馬外側。末段保持走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Missed the start by a length and dragged back to find the rail 7Ls or so behind the leader, made up decent ground and did his best work late (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 漏閘，失去一個馬位，留後，落後領放馬約七個馬位，走內欄。其後追前甚多，末段表現最佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, smooth headway on bend, strong run to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎以暢順走勢上前。走勢強勁，二百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Track leaders, quickened early in home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W5W) Sat behind midfield, traveled comfortably, showed some dash over the last 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W5W) 居中間之後位置。走勢暢順。最後一百米略為加速上前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Snitzel from Response, a daughter of Charge Forward. Horses by the same sire include Solid State and Cap Ferrat. This fellow had six starts for two wins (a maiden over 1100m and a handicap over 1300m) and one placing. He was given four trials for one win in Hong Kong. He made all to win by 2-3/4Ls, under slight pressure, over 800m on turf at Sha Tin on May 26. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fourth under pressure, beaten by 4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on September 17. He is not looking like a first-start winner here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「犀利時」(Snitzel)之後，在港同父馬包括「實力股」及「百賀飛駒」等駒，生母出自「進攻」(Charge Forward)。來港前在澳洲六戰得兩勝一位，頭馬包括一場1100米從未勝出馬賽，及一場1300米讓賽。抵港後四次試閘得一勝。5月26日出試田草800米，早段領放，末段稍騎下以2.75個馬位之先勝出。最近9月17日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第四名，落後頭馬四個馬位。不似能一出即勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Jumped well, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped nicely, sat outside lead, ran on strongly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。末段以勁勢上前，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Commenced well from wide draw and across to lead, hung left under pressure home straight, headed 200m out, stuck to task but winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速後切入領放。直路上在催策下外閃。二百米處被超越。持續力拼，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled greenly, lay in throughout, difficult to be fully ridden out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。走勢稚嫩。沿途內閃。難以被全力催策。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Quickly into stride, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Jumped fairly, maintained position just off the lead 2Ls on settling, didn't finish it off passing 300M, eased when no chance. (Requires further assessment.)
(Have a heart condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;出閘一般，居領放馬稍後位置，落後兩個馬位。跑過三百米處時衝刺乏力。再無爭勝機會時收慢。（須接受進一步評估。）
（心臟有問題。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) In rear after awkward start, had to wait for run turning into home straight, hung right in home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路上內閃。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace towards centre of course, effort 400m out, gave ground final 200m.
(Laceration to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
