中等步速;出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞。在跑道中央跟隨領放馬。四百米處發力。最後二百米墮退。
（右後腿割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Clean jump, took the lead, led by 1-1/2L in the middle stages, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘俐落，取得領先。中段領先一個半馬位。保持佳勢至終點，取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, chased leaders into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, raced keenly in the middle stages, responded nicely when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。中段搶口。對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Disputed lead, led outright 300m out, soon challenged by winner, found that rival too strong final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 爭奪領先。三百米處單騎領放，瞬即被頭馬挑戰，最後一百五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily, briefly hampered close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持穩勢，接近終點時一度受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, under pressure top of home straight, headed 300m out, dropped away quickly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越。最後一百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat outside the leader, gave ground final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米墮退。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Power from Sunny Desert, a daughter of Wild Desert. Horses by the same sire include Natural High and Mighty Giant. This fellow had one start for one win (a maiden handicap over 1110m). He was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat not far from the pace and finished third under pressure, beaten by 2-1/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 2. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「強勁力量」(Power)之後，在港同父馬包括「贏得自然」及「高大威猛」等駒，生母出自Wild Desert。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1110米從未勝出馬讓磅賽。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。最近10月2日出試田泥1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬2.25個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front, disputed led final bend, headed top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。在領放下受追迫。直路彎爭奪領先。直路初被超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) From draw 3 obtained a 2-wide position ahead of midfield, urged along nearing 400M, ran home only fairly under pressure posing o threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近四百米處時受催策。末段在催策下走勢僅屬一般，未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced prominently, 2 wide, positioned 1 out 1 back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎居第二疊第二位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Prominent, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, stayed on well and in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, unable to quicken over 300m out, stuck to task, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處未能加速。持續力拼，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well from a wide draw, trapped 3 wide with no cover, a length or so back, hampered near 600M, 4 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。接近六百米處時受阻礙。入直路時走第四疊。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Held a forward position outside leader, right there turning for home but peaked on his run mid-straight and failed to finish the job.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側的前列位置。轉直路彎時居好位，但直路中段未能再增速。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W2W3W) Bustled along after the start to obtain a position ahead of midfield, shifted in abruptly 500M resulting in rider losing balance, failed to pick up pace in the straight. (Warning placed on the horse's racing manners.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W2W3W) 起步後受催策以佔取中間之前位置。五百米處急促向內斜跑，導致騎師失去平衡。直路上未能加速。（小組就此駒的走勢發出警告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Travelled alongside wire-to-wire winner early stages, shifted in for rails run in 2nd onto home bend, given reminders to hold place upon straightening but swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段與一放到底的頭馬並跑。開始轉直路彎時移入內欄，居第二位。入直路時受鞭策以保持位置，但最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure 400m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Moved up to press leader on outside, ran home one paced early straight, lost 2nd inside 200M and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 上前追迫領放馬，走外疊。直路早段保持同速。最後二百米失去第二位及轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced very wide without cover throughout, under pressure 500m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, ran on well to lead 200m out, headed close home, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先。接近終點時被超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, raced very wide throughout, detached in home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。沿途走大外疊。直路上被拋離。大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, 2 wide after passing 900M, still well back on turn, weakened early in straight, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走內疊。跑過九百米處後走第二疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路初轉弱。包尾大敗而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position on bend, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置。二百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the inside, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走內疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策毫無反應，最後二百米轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Settled ahead of midfield, steadied when crowded near 900M then raced keenly for some distance, lacked a finishing response in the straight. Never a serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置。接近九百米處時在受擠迫之際收慢，其後在一段途程上搶口。直路上在催策下衝刺乏力。從未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, ran on well final 200m to close on leaders late but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米以佳勢上前，末段追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide turning in, no clear run early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, made contact near 250M, eased inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。接近二百五十米處時與對手互相觸碰。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Three wide early stages, improved to tracked leaders 800m out, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段走第三疊。八百米處推進以跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear, unable to secure clear run until 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。未能望空直至三百五十米處，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, tight for room top of home straight, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受緊迫。走勢良佳，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From a wide draw slotted into a 2-wide spot in midfield, brought wide 400M to challenge, finished off best final 200M to take 3rd close home. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百米處移出外疊以展開挑戰。最後二百米衝刺最佳，接近終點時取得第三名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield in the early and middle stages, moved up to join leaders passing 600M, hit lead 300M out but proved no match for winner from mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段及中段居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。上前，跑過六百米處時追上領先馬匹。三百米處取得領先，但自直路中段起不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, ran on well to lead 100m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，一百米處取得領先。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, pushed along to chase leaders 550m out, gave ground final 300m, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百五十米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。最後三百米墮退，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, shifted right in home straight, bumped 350m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上向內斜跑。三百五十米處發生碰撞。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至三百米處。以佳勢上前，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Four wide in mid-field without cover, good headway on bend to chase leaders, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W6W) In rear out wide, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W6W) 居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Settled in mid-field, keen early, ridden top of home straight, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。直路初受催策。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Clean jump, raced 3 wide in midfield, there to turn, ridden after passing 300M, showed very good response, led close home but unable to hold off the winner on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘俐落，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置，跑過三百米處後受催策，反應甚佳。接近終點時取得領先，但過終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, ridden top of home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。直路初受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the outside, still well back on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, joined by rivals 600m out, headed top of home straight, stayed on well to fight back and lead 100m out, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後切入以領放。六百米處被對手追及。直路初被超越。末段保持佳勢，一百米處反先對手取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Keen in wide position, quickly left behind from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 搶口，走外疊。自四百米處起迅速被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear, 2 wide, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in rear, switched wide for clear run 300m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居後列。三百米處移出外疊以望空。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W5W) Awkward start and lost ground, detached early stages, good headway halfway out, pushed along widest into home straight, passed plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，早段被拋離。半程時追前甚多。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began awkwardly, raced as the rear over 10Ls off the pace at one stage, had task in hand leaving the bend, failed to make up ground on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，一度落後領放馬逾十個馬位。跑離直路彎時落後頗遠。未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, unable to quicken, eased final 100m.
(Roarer again and sustained a minor abrasion to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Roarer again and sustained a minor abrasion to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策，未能加速。最後一百米收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症及右後腿輕微擦傷。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （再次患有喘鳴症及右後腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W6W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide behind midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W6W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Soon taken behind from a poor draw, commenced move 4-wide rounding home bend, unbalanced briefly on straightening, ran on under pressure but run ended just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自第九檔出閘後瞬即留後。轉直路彎時開始上前，走第四疊。入直路時一度失去平衡。在催策下保持走勢，但跑過一百米處後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in rear, still in rear into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列。入直路時仍居後列。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, driven along 600m out, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Shifted in and heavily bumped out of stalls, waited with towards rear, under pressure 700m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，發生大力碰撞。居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策，末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped start and unbalanced, raced towards rear, effort 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時被碰撞及失去平衡，居後列。四百米處受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, taken wider into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時被帶出較外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, without cover halfway out, taken wider on bend, eased 350m out when jockey was concerned with his action.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。半程時沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。三百五十米處在騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮之際收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made good ground early part of the Straight, just one pace late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路早段追前甚多，但末段僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover midfield, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Crowded on jumping from a wide draw then taken back to race at the rear, ran on fairly without threat to the leaders. Had difficulty obtaining clear running near 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘時受擠迫，其後留居後列。走勢一般，未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。接近一百米處時難以望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay, peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。衝刺不俗，一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。趨近一百米處時未能再增速及被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, short of room early in home straight, badly held up for clear running final 150m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初空位不足。最後一百五十米嚴重受困而未能望空，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to vie for lead obtaining rails run in front just inside the 1200M, held over 1L advantage into straight but unable to sustain effort and caught 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，爭奪領先。跑過千二米處後在領放下移入內欄。入直路時領先逾一個馬位，但其後無以為繼，五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, easy run to turn, angled out early in straight, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路初向外移出。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，僅以一馬頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, ran on well but headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初加速。二百米處取得領先。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from 400m out, stayed on but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢，但不敵頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W7W) Jumped with them, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, no cover from 800M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W7W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。自八百米處起沒有遮擋。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, kicked 400m out, stayed on well in home straight and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 一放到底。四百米處加速。直路上保持佳勢，瞬即控制大局。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Box seat, well placed into home straight, bumped and lost balance 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。三百米處被碰撞，失去平衡。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W2W) Allowed to stride on and take narrow lead before halfway, headed 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 獲許展步上前，半程前領先短距離。二百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W1W) Wide early, sent forward and led after 500m, headed over 200m out, soon weakened.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 早段走外疊。受催策上前，跑了五百米後領放。二百米處被超越，瞬即轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, could not be quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, well placed into home straight, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, 8 lengths or so back turning in, taken wide in straight and made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上移出外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, shuffled back to last rounding Home Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時墮居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W2W3W) Hampered 1300M out before settling in last few on rail, went wide for a run entering home straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 千三米處受阻礙，其後居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時移出外疊取位。末段在跑道中央受催策上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield in 6th within 5L off the pace, went wide for a run into straight but could only run home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間第六位，落後領放馬不逾五個馬位。入直路時走外疊取位，但末段僅保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled not far off on rail, drifted some 4L off the pace in 5th about 1200M out, slightly closer into home straight, fought on under pressure to reach 2.5L 2nd 100M out but without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 落後領先馬匹不遠，走內欄。約千二米處居第五位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。入直路時略為追近。在催策下力拼，一百米處進佔第二位，落後兩個半馬位，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat rear, switched out at the Turn, lay in in the Straight, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。直路上內閃。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Broke well settling towards rear, 3-wide behind midfield early in back straight before gaining closer to within 4L of pace briefly 700M out, soon drifted some 5L back to 8th onto home bend, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居後列。對面直路早段居中間之後位置，走第三疊。七百米處追近，一度落後領放馬不逾四個馬位。開始轉直路彎時瞬即墮退至第八位，落後約五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, still in rear top of home straight, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From draw 3 obtained a midfield position along the fence, driven along 400M but only showed limited response. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策，但反應僅屬平平。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, tracked leaders, under pressure to chase leaders 600m out, stayed on well, lost second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。其後保持佳勢。接近終點時失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, found rail 550M, no daylight early in straight, made minor progress after passing 250M, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處移入內欄。直路早段未能望空。跑過二百五十米處後略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Bumped exiting stalls, mid division, pushed along wide 500m out, short-lived challenge top of home straight, stayed on for pressure final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處受推策，走外疊。直路初一度發力挑戰。二百米處在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Away well, raced in midfield on the outside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 550m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, pushed along to chase leader 500m out, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。五百米處受推策以追趕領放馬。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, found rail near 800M, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近八百米處時移入內欄。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Moderately away, raced 2 better than midfield in the early stages, found rail approaching 800M, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 出閘普通，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。趨近八百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well and raced in a share of lead, ridden and opened up clear advantage from 300m out, just kept up to work final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，並排領先。自三百米處起受催策及拋離對手。最後五十米僅保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Average to begin, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along 400m out to chase leaders, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickened early to lead 350m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。率先加速，三百五十米處取得領先。走勢良佳，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight, won by 2-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以兩個半馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked leader on inside, came with a strong looking challenge 250M, tried hard but was always held by the winner. (Jockey - given the option of obtaining cover if circumstances permitted.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內疊。二百五十米處以勁勢上前挑戰。力拼，但一直落後頭馬。（騎師表示，他獲指示可選擇在情況許可下讓坐騎取得遮擋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Began smartly from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on strongly in straight and won by 1-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持勁勢，以一個半馬位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, box seat, well placed into home straight, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, ran on strongly to kick two lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。走勢強勁，二百米處加速帶離對手兩個馬位，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began smartly from gate 13, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 250M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策略有反應。二百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 3rd, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood at the left nostril.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後約一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）
（左邊鼻孔有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Fast away from the stalls and sat up on leader's girth, struck the lead when asked 300m out, but unable to hold off the strong-finishing challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。三百米處在催策下取得領先，但未能抗衡衝刺強勁的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 400m out, stayed on for pressure, weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。在催策下保持走勢。接近終點時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began smartly, raced in 2nd, 1/2L back turning in, took the lead 300M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後半個馬位。三百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Began only fairly, settled towards the rear of the main group 4Ls off the pace, responded moderately final 300M, was making some progress on leaders but couldn't be ridden out late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居主馬群後列，落後領放馬四個馬位。最後三百米對催策反應普通，略為追近領先馬匹，但末段未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, towards rear, had to wait for run between 400m out and 300m out, stayed on, nearly got up for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。四百米處至三百米處之間須等待空位出現。保持穩勢，幾乎跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out 450M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders out wide, stayed in contention until no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。保持爭逐機會，直至最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, forced to steady on heels 800m out, switched inside for clear run 300m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。三百米處移入內疊以望空。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, pressed by runner-up but stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先。末段被亞軍馬匹追迫，但保持佳勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, crowded middle stages, under pressure 500m out, well held from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。中段受擠迫。五百米處受催策。自三百米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced prominently behind leader, failed to run on passing 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬之後的前列位置。跑過三百米處時未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Crowded on jumping, raced 3 wide in midfield early, 2 wide from 750M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 躍出時受擠迫。早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自七百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Away awkwardly and lost ground, settled back in the field, last turning home, failed to run on under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。轉直路彎時居包尾位置。其後在催策下未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Away with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初向外移出，衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Broke well from the one draw settling one back on rail in 3rd, unable to quicken under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。直路上在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced prominently on the inside, 1/4L back turning in, kept on well to take 2nd, always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居前列，走內疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Caught wide early from draw 10 before obtaining a prominent spot outside leader 700M out, fought hard in the straight vying for the lead, kept on well to the line only beaten narrowly by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘，早段走外疊。七百米處佔取領放馬外側的前列位置。直路上力拼，爭奪領先。末段保持佳勢，僅以短距離之差不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leading pair, impeded briefly 200m out when trying to make effort, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處嘗試發力時一度受阻。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。三百五十米處加速。末段以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Chased leader, didn't travel with much fluency, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走勢欠順。直路初受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made all, pressed in front, responded well when pressed on 300m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 一放到底。在領放下受追迫。三百米處在催策下反應良佳。保持佳勢，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Clean jump, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, took the lead approaching 250M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘俐落，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。趨近二百五十米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear along the inside, 5Ls to make up 400M but couldn't muster the pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。四百米處落後五個馬位，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W5W) Out in line, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, commenced move approaching 400M, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。趨近四百米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled handy on the rail, checked near 350M, not much impression made. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居前列，走內欄。接近三百五十米處時勒避。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 stayed close enough behind leaders, held up for clear running 400M to 200M but the finishing response was only mild over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空，末段對催策反應僅屬普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, weakened under pressure in the Straight.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上在催策下轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Bumped at the start, switched off to race in detached last 8-9Ls off the pace, had plenty to do 300M but ran past beaten horses only. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置，遙遙落後領放馬八至九個馬位。三百米處仍落後頗遠，但末段僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along final bend, challenged up rail from 200m out, tight for room and bumped 150m out, ran on well to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。一百五十米處受緊迫及發生碰撞。以佳勢上前，過終點時險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began well before easing back to race in midfield, lay in home straight and proved difficult to ride under 7lb claimer, did best work late to claim 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，收慢留居中間位置。直路上內閃，在獲減七磅的騎師胯下難以策騎。末段表現最佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W) Gradually taken back from the widest draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W) 自最外檔出閘後逐漸留後。從未見具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Close up early, dropped towards rear approaching the 1000M bend, remained in a similar position to home straight, fought on steadily under pressure despite a tight run just inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段緊隨領放馬。趨近一千米處彎位時墮居後列。直路前仍居相若位置。儘管於跑過二百米處後緊迫競跑，但在催策下持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, headway up rail and made up several places in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路上沿欄追前數位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped on terms, eased back to race towards the rear, closed off steadily final 300M without posing threat to first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，收慢留居後列。最後三百米衝刺平穩，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden top of home straight, one paced under pressure, just missed third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初受催策。在催策下保持同速。僅失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, chased leader, strong run to lead 300m out, kicked 3 lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，追趕領放馬。走勢強勁，三百米處取得領先。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。拋離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped on terms from draw 1, reserved in midfield on settling, held up for clear running from 400m to 200M before finishing off well. Not ridden out close home when racing tight. Could have finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔與對手同步躍出，留居中間位置。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空。其後衝刺良佳。接近終點緊迫競跑時未能被力策。本應有望跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away in line, settled down midfield 4Ls off the pace, into clear running 350M, stayed on fairly well to go 3rd near line. Not reach first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，落後領放馬四個馬位。三百五十米處望空。保持不俗走勢，接近終點時進佔第三位，但未能追上頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Disputed led, challenged by rivals top of home straight, headed 250m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 爭奪領先。直路初受對手挑戰。二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Settled in 4th always in touch with leaders, travelled best of all at 400M, quickened to grab narrow lead inside 200M, stuck to task well late and was always holding off the persistent 2nd under confident riding.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 居第四位，一直跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處走勢最佳。加速上前，二百米處以短距離領先。末段持續以佳勢力拼，在力策下力拒持續挑戰的亞軍馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped leaving stalls, in rear out wide, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, not hurried and settled towards the rear 6Ls back, brought wide 300M but responded only fairly. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，未受催策，居後列，落後六個馬位。三百米處移出外疊，但對催策反應僅屬一般。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped only fairly, ended up as the back marker from 600M, couldn't keep up 400M, soon beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘僅屬一般。自六百米處起居包尾位置，四百米處未能跟上對手，瞬即洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled just worse than midfield, found no extra upon straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍後位置。入直路後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Crowded at start, settled just worse than midfield, saved ground on the inside turning for home, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間稍後位置。轉直路彎時走內疊節省腳程。穩步上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from draw 1, restrained to a midfield spot, raced keenly in the middle stages, kept on well enough in the straight but not going the pace of first two final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。中段搶口。直路上保持佳勢，但最後二百米加速力不及頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, reserved behind midfield in a fast run race, finished off fairly well final 300M but not going the pace of first two closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居中間之後位置，賽事步速偏快。最後三百米衝刺不俗，但末段加速力不及頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Sat midfield center field, crowded at 500M, weakened and faded thereafter. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;居中間位置，在跑道中央競跑。五百米處受擠迫，其後轉弱及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Began well from a wide draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W) Chased leaders along the fence, within striking distance turning home, responded well and dug deep final 200M to overhaul the long-time leader near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 沿欄追趕領先馬匹。入直路時落後領放馬不遠。最後二百米對催策反應良佳，持續力拼，接近終點時超越沿途帶頭的領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed near 250M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。接近二百五十米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再加速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Quickly away, soon in front and led uncontested to the straight, headed mid-straight then faded to finish 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，瞬即帶頭，單騎領放至直路。直路中段被超越，其後力竭，以第四名過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 13 showed customary pace to cross to the lead , became immediately under pressure when challenged by rival nearing 300M before giving ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十三檔出閘，展現一貫前速，切入領放。接近三百米處時受對手挑戰之際立即受催策，其後墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Stumbled shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on well in straight to hold off the challenger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久失蹄，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持佳勢，力拒對手挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Shifted out at start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, dropped towards rear on turn, 6 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路彎墮居後列。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Disputed lead, unable to match winner from 300m line but stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先。自三百米處起未能追上頭馬，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tended to hang out throughout, forced to steady on heels 700m out, lost touch final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。沿途傾向外閃。七百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Controlled the tempo up front after a quick getaway, fought bravely final stages only fell short to a classy horse.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，其後上前，主宰步速。末段奮勇力拼，僅負於實力強勁的一駒，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W) Went for the lead on jumping from draw 11, crossed to the fence 800M and led steadily, was strongly challenged by rival final 250M but kept going well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後上前帶頭。八百米處切入內欄，以平穩步速領放。最後二百五十米受對手以勁勢挑戰，但保持佳勢，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well in front early stages, gradually taken one back on rail about 1000M out, came to challenge inside the 300M holding some chance but found winner to good.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段領先。約一千米處逐漸留後一個馬位，走內欄。三百米處展開挑戰，頗具勝望，但不敵頭馬。
